{{Quote|My Circlings have seen the flying cities, black against the stars.|The Queen of the Red, referring to the ''Admonitor''|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Quethold system''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contained several [[Star/Legends|stars]] and the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. The latter was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which spoke the [[Language/Legends|languages]] known as [[Quesoth Common Speak]] and [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

At some point after [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] against the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]<ref name="Choices">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Poln">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]</ref> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="CD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the former's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'', traveled to Quethold. It [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the planet in order to prevent Esva, who had allied himself with Quethold's [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|reigning]] [[Queen of the Red]], from escaping. After [[Attack on the Red City|defeating]] the warlord's forces<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Thrawn's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|warship]] left<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> the [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> for the [[Chaos Triangle]] with the goal of dealing with what the Grand Admiral referred to as Esva's "legacy."<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Quethold, and therefore its star system, appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', published within the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], subsequently named the system and placed it in grid square I-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
